asr.full_text: Hi, I'm Angela, and in this short video I want to explain how to position members in the network, new signed members, and how to buy them. To position me, I use the profile menu, and here, I have the link for promotion. We want to promote the business In the top part, we have a promote link, which will bring people who are interested to start your business. In the News Member places we can also choose our people for our network, considering that our network the best for us. What this tells us is that we always have a team to the left and one to the right a team will be stronger, because you will be helped by the sponsoring line which will position their members in the right line The most important role that a sponsor can play as an investor in your team is providing support and guidance to you, as you know from every individual. It is important to know that the more you participate in your team, the more you will get support and guidance. This is one on the right, then I´ve to activate the right position, I click on Save Settings and that´s OK! the people that will sign it will sign into the left team. If the weakest team is the one on the right is weaker, then select Left and click Save, and all the people that will be registered will be registered in the left team. Here you can select the right password you can select the right transaction, the PIN the email address personal data a photo and most importantly you can select the country and of course the name You can select Romanian language if you don't good at english now to buy tokens There are two possibilities Either we click on the Account menu Go to account registration And here we go to buy tokens We are directed to the platform where the token is being transacted The bid option is where you can buy and sell tokens. If you click on BID the form opens with the number of tokens we want to buy, the minimum number being 50, and to put them down we drag the pin, click on the Place Order button and that's it. Later on, there is no need to do anything at all, because we've selected from the beginning the money mining to be automated, when it's time to buy the tokens rows, the mining process to automatic When the token turn on the purchase you will be able to see it on your desktop and the company will automatically take it and place it in the mining process The same works if you also can add the Exchanges menu Here to trade We are directed to the same transactional platform That's about it for these two menus I hope this will help you... and wish you success! Bye!

textual.observation: The tutorial directs viewers to buy tokens, specifies a minimum purchase of 50, and describes selecting automated "money mining" in which the company will automatically place the tokens into the mining process.

evidence.quote: the money mining to be automated
the company will automatically take it and place it in the mining process

textual.context: The source presents these statements as instructions in a tutorial. The phrase "money mining" is used by the speaker; the records do not establish whether it represents a guaranteed return or how the process operates.
textual.potential_relevance: A requested token purchase with a stated minimum is linked to an automated process described as "money mining" and involving company handling of the tokens, creating a task-relevant purchase/return relationship for later contextual assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish that money or tokens were actually transferred, the recipient or terms of any transaction, the meaning or outcome of "money mining," or whether any return was promised or achieved.

textual_context_notes.observation: The material is framed as an instructional explanation about network member positioning and token purchasing; whether it is promotional beyond that tutorial framing is not established by these records.

evidence.quote: in this short video I want to explain how to position members in the network
We are directed to the platform where the token is being transacted

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes joining a sponsor-controlled left/right network, buying tokens, and an automated process presented as money mining that requires no further action. The speaker directly explains how to recruit and position members while encouraging participation in the token platform, rather than warning about or investigating the offer.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S04 fits because the video links token purchase to an automated mining process and presents that process as generating money with little or no ongoing effort. The content is an instructional promotion of participation, not merely market commentary or a neutral interface demonstration.

evidence.observation: The speaker explicitly frames the video as promotion of the business.
evidence.quote: We want to promote the business

evidence.observation: The speaker presents automated money mining as a selected platform feature.
evidence.quote: we've selected from the beginning the money mining to be automated

evidence.observation: The video makes a passive, no-further-action representation about the token-linked mining process.
evidence.quote: Later on, there is no need to do anything at all, because we've selected from the beginning the money mining to be automated

evidence.observation: The speaker explains a two-sided team structure for placing recruited members.
evidence.quote: we always have a team to the left and one to the right

evidence.observation: The token purchase interface is described as requiring a minimum order of 50 tokens.
The interface visibly shows an invite link and a button to sign up a new member with the presenter as sponsor, alongside left/right member placement controls.
